description: Illinois motorcycle delta: helmet law and lane rules. National riding skills stay in core_motorcycle.json.

questions.q: An Illinois Class M instruction permit allows riding
options: Only in daylight, supervised by a Class M holder 21+ with a year of experience, and no passengers
At any hour and alone, as long as the rider carries the permit and wears a helmet at all times
With one passenger who is 21 or older, in daylight only, and never on an interstate highway
Only on private property, until the rider passes the riding skills test at Driver Services
questions.explanation: The permit carries a daylight-only restriction under the direct supervision of a licensed motorcyclist 21 or older with at least one year of experience. Permit holders may not carry passengers.

questions.q: An Illinois Class M instruction permit for a 16- or 17-year-old requires
options: Completed driver education and an IDOT motorcycle training course
Only a passing score on the motorcycle written test at the facility
A parent or guardian signature and nothing else before the permit
A Class D car license held for at least one year without violations
questions.explanation: Applicants under 18 must complete an approved driver education course and an IDOT-approved motorcycle training course. Their permit runs 24 months; an adult's runs 12.

questions.q: An Illinois applicant 18 or older who completes an IDOT motorcycle training course
options: Does not need the written or riding test at a Driver Services facility
Must still pass both the written test and the riding test at the facility
Receives only an instruction permit and must ride supervised for 12 months
Must hold the instruction permit for one year before the riding test
questions.explanation: Adults who successfully complete an IDOT course are exempt from the written and driving exams at Driver Services. Applicants under 18 still take the riding test.

questions.q: Who must wear a helmet on a motorcycle in Illinois?
options: Riders under 21
No statewide helmet requirement
Riders under 20
Riders under 19
questions.explanation: Illinois helmet law: no statewide helmet requirement.

questions.q: What does Illinois law say about riding a motorcycle between lanes of traffic?
options: Only lane filtering is allowed, when traffic is stopped or slow
Riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed
Lane splitting is legal
questions.explanation: Illinois: riding between lanes of traffic is not allowed.

questions.q: What does Illinois require for a motorcycle rider's eye protection?
options: Not required by state law
Required for all riders
Required unless the motorcycle has a windshield
questions.explanation: Illinois: eye protection is required unless the motorcycle has a windshield.

questions.q: In Illinois, what is the youngest age for a motorcycle learner's permit?
options: 16 years
15½ years
15 years
17 years
questions.explanation: Illinois issues a motorcycle permit at 16 years at the earliest.
